m.t: É a única coisa de que ela gosta mais do que esmagar cérebros.
m.e: It's about the only thing she loves more than bashing in brains.

m.e: Yeah. Well, three of them were big fans of brains.

m.e: And then there's the brain-eating and the dance moves.

m.e: Well, but so is painting the walls in here with you people's tiny brains.

m.e: The only brains they want are human ones.

m.e: We get our brains from a medical testing facility.

m.t: - É onde ele diz que arranja os cérebros.

m.e: Eating brains sucks beyond words.

m.e: You've got to worry about paying taxes, eating brains.

m.e: Now, Blaine killed those kids and I ate those brains.

m.t: Toda esta merda doentia vem dos vossos cérebros.
m.e: All this sick weird shit's coming from your brains.

m.e: Oh, boy. So... what do my beautiful-brained colleagues have for me tonight?

m.t: Tipo ... Terem melhor desempenho que os outros grupos?
m.e: Like... you... out-perform the other groups?

m.t: Guarda algum desse material para a minha avaliação de desempenho.
m.e: Save some of that material for my performance review.

m.e: And therefore we can predict the performance of a network when its large.

m.e: You might still have a little performance anxiety.

m.e: How close to the envelope, the peak of performance, are these guys?

m.t: Não, "desempenho", é o meu trabalho, de uma forma geral.
m.e: No, "performance" means my work in general.

m.t: Eles dizem que não temos o mesmo desempenho é verdade.

m.e: How many reports does one man need on his performance? My God!

m.t: Com elevado desempenho na velocidade máxima e na aceleração.

m.t: É por isso que estou a fazer as avaliações de desempenho.
m.e: That's why I'm doing the performance reviews.

m.e: It appears no one has sobered from last night's performance.

m.e: After that last performance we've already reconsidered it for you.
